newsitem.title: USA: Candela sees profitable locations by end 97.
newsitem.headline: Candela sees profitable locations by end 97.

text.p: Candela Corp said Wednesday that it expects to see its Boston and Cairo, Egypt treatment locations profitable by the end of 1997.
The maker of lasers used in cosmetic and medical procedures also said that it expects its Scottsdale, Ariz. location to turn a profit by mid-1998.
The company also announced second quarter and six month earnings.
For the second quarter, the company reported a loss of $0.23 a share or $1.3 million, compared to a profit of $0.12 a share or $658,000 during the same time last year.
In the first six months of 1997, the company reported net income of $0.04 a share or $238,000 compared to a profit of $0.22 a share or $1.2 million during the period a year ago.
